frontend.duration_policy: Reject shorter than two valid feature frames or longer than 30 seconds; no silent truncation, resampling or chunking.
frontend.dither_ambiguity: The NeMo archive config says 1e-5; the pinned Transformers and CUDA paths omit dither. This qualification explicitly follows the nondithered Transformers path and makes no MLX/NeMo parity claim.
frontend.window: Hann periodic=false, centered in 512 samples (56 zeros each side)
frontend.stft: center=true, constant zero padding 256 samples each side
frontend.mel: 128 filters, Slaney scale and area normalization, 0..8000Hz, float32 filter storage
frontend.normalization: Mean over valid frames; variance divided by valid_frames-1; divide by sqrt(variance)+1e-5; zero masked output frames.
frontend.subsampling_mask_lengths: ceil(valid_frames/2), then ceil(/2), then ceil(/2); stored lengths propagate separately.
frontend.silence_policy: Preserve source equations; do not force normalized silence to zero. FP32 reduction order requires explicit device tolerance qualification.

conformer.attention: Noncausal eager FP32 softmax with relative positions; valid-query AND valid-key mask applied to relative scores as finite float32 minimum before content-score addition.
conformer.convolution_mask: Zero invalid rows after GLU and before depthwise convolution. Do not zero residuals or final padded rows.
conformer.qualification_envelope: Batch 1, H=1024, F=4096, 8 heads, kernel=9, 1..8 stored encoder frames, nonempty contiguous valid prefix.

tdt.selection: Independent argmax over token logits [0:8193] and duration logits [8193:8198]; never one argmax over all 8198.
tdt.pinned_transformers_guard: If blank and predicted duration is zero, advance one encoder frame. A nonblank zero-duration emission does not advance the frame.
tdt.runtime_disagreement: Fermion CUDA additionally forces advance after max_symbols_per_step=10 zero-duration emissions; the inspected Transformers TDT update does not apply that guard. This slice implements neither decoder and does not silently substitute one policy.
tdt.future_liveness_requirement: Select and qualify the decoder policy before device integration. A safety watchdog must report an incomplete/error result rather than inventing a transcript or silently changing duration semantics.
